prompt: acoustic sketch: guitar, quiet drums, a real guitar solo; short, unmixed

requests.ask: make a new short acoustic song: guitar and quiet drums, get something simple up, do not mix yet, but an amazing guitar solo

changes.why: strumstick stands for the guitar (no guitar in the packs), folkharp for the low end, cajon and shakers as the kit
phrase 8, one written eight-bar line with 16th runs and degrees past the octave, register .5 so the high runs stay inside the strumstick's sampled range
bVI instead of VI: dorian's VI is C#dim, the lift wanted is C

requests.ask: not even close: no guitar anywhere? and it sounds electronic, not acoustic; the solo melody is the closest, keep it and give me more

changes.why: gm_acoustic_guitar_steel for every guitar and gm_acoustic_bass under it: the GM soundfonts are the only guitars Strudel has, wired in with web/soundfonts.mjs
the picking and the bass are raw note().s() parts: the pad layer put a 120 ms attack and a filter on every pluck and the bass layer a filter envelope, which is what read as electronic
a second eight-bar line answering the first (kept verbatim), sixteenths from the top and a pedal-point lick, the climax
drums on a written grid (kick 1 and the and-of-3, snare 2 and 4, shaker eighths) instead of the house template
gain .8>.4 and lead level 1>1.4: the bass sat 8 dB over the soloist in the render; a sanity level, the mixing pass is still to come

requests.ask: so good: visual ink; three more solos with breaks, the last really going for it as the climax; then a final mix

changes.why: five solos: solo and solo2 trade, break (the hook at half speed, no drums), solo3 breathes over a halftime kit with rests and double-stops, solo4 climbs in sweeps and a rising pedal lick, pickup (two bars of guitar alone), solo5 the climax: sixteenths and sextuplets, tremolo picking up the scale, the high root held; melody2 counter-line in solo2, solo4 and solo5
room ir room size .9 with packs rooms: one small box for the whole band, every part's space a send
raw2.position 0>-.35 raw2.brightness .5>.42 raw2.space .5>.6: the picking sat at the lead's level in the measure, dead centre and masking it in the mid band (.28); off to the left, darker and farther
raw.space .5>.35: the bass as foundation, 7 dB under the mix, dry
(solo5 1.9) melody.space .5>.4: the lead as the foreground, closest and driest, 3 dB under the mix
(solo5 2) melody2.position 0>.35 melody2.compressor -18/3: it measured 32 dB under the mix, inaudible; the compressor for its crest of 25, off to the right against the picking
(solo5 .75>.36): quiet drums, 9 dB under the mix in the climax where they were the loudest part
duck ruled out: the kick-under-bass masking measured .09, nothing to duck

requests.ask: I don't like melody2, it makes a horrible ping sound

changes.why: cut: the steel guitar two octaves up through a compressor and the room read as a ping; the solos carry the climax alone
